name: neo-nexus
description: Connect Codex engineering work with Neo-Nexus projects, client requests, and daily project summaries.

interface.shortDescription: Work on Neo-Nexus client requests from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Gives engineers permission-checked identity, project context, client tasks and issues, and Neo-Nexus tracking health inside Codex. While Codex is open, it asks Neo-Nexus to publish one evidence-backed daily summary per connected project. Task status changes and summary runs are attributed to the authenticated engineer and approved device. It never sends prompts or source files.
defaultPrompt: Who am I connected as in Neo-Nexus?
Show the Neo-Nexus context for this project.
What client requests should I work on?
Check Neo-Nexus tracking health for this repo.
